subtasks.title: Lower the two Scout zoom-visibility floors 12 -> 11 and rebuild assets
subtasks.approach: In resources/js/clarity-scout/components/ScannerMap.vue, change PATH_LAYERS_MIN_ZOOM (line 134) from 12 to 11 and RANGE_HIT_MARKERS_MIN_ZOOM (line 129) from 12 to 11. Leave every other zoom constant/literal untouched (NO_SCAN_LABEL_MIN_ZOOM already 11; TRAIL_ARROWS_MIN_ZOOM=14, LIVE_ZOOM=16, bootZoom/fallbackZoom=12 all out of scope per Dalton). Then run `npm run build` and commit the regenerated public/build assets + manifest.json. Revert any boost-doc regen (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.junie) that npm build sweeps in.

excluded_sites.reason: already at the target floor; not named.
camera punch-in target, not a visibility gate.
default VIEW zoom; Dalton confirmed unchanged.

testing_note: JS-only change; repo has NO JS test runner. Per CLAUDE.md execution policy ('Never run unit tests automatically; CI runs tests after commit'), no local test suite run — the change touches zero PHP so the PHP suite is irrelevant. Verification is agent/human QA at the Scout map (zoom-11 boundary) + CI on push.
perf_note: No deferred-perf CH design on a >1B-row surface: no query, endpoint, or schema changes. The existing (uncapped) scan-path fetch is unchanged; lowering the floor merely lets it fire one zoom level (~4x viewport area) further out. That widening risk is a QA verification item (60-day range at zoom 11), not a Phase 3.5 perf-gate trigger. perf_validation.required=false.
